text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One night, Mejiro Dober asks me to<n>come with her
to speak with Air<n>Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She thanks Air Groove for guiding her<n>all this time,
handing her a single<n>flower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The flower is a yellow carnation—a<n>declaration of
challenge to Air Groove<n>and a promise that Mejiro
Dober will<n>surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove willingly accepts her<n>challenge and
promises to see her<n>again at the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Relieved she was able to voice her<n>desires in front
of both Air Groove<n>and me, a smile spreads across
Mejiro Dober's face.
